description: This file contains the implementation of a SCSS parser class, 'Parser', responsible for parsing SCSS/SASS source code into an abstract syntax tree (AST). It includes methods for handling various Sass constructs such as rules, directives, blocks, expressions, functions, and media queries. The class manages the tokenization, syntax validation, and tree construction, with support for caching and error handling.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing SCSS source code into an abstract syntax tree (AST). Handles tokenization, syntax validation, and tree construction for SCSS constructs including rules, directives, media queries, functions, and expressions. Supports caching and error reporting.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main entry point for parsing SCSS source code buffer into a Block AST.

methods.name: parseValue
methods.description: Parses a SCSS value or list of values from a buffer.

methods.name: parseSelector
methods.description: Parses a CSS selector or list of selectors from a buffer.

methods.name: parseMediaQueryList
methods.description: Parses a list of media queries.

methods.name: getSourceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the source file being parsed.
